description: Extract data from document sets with citations.

interface.longDescription: Extract data from document sets with citations. Turn collections of contracts, reports, invoices, and other documents into structured results you can trace back to the source. Define the fields you need, compare information across documents, calculate derived metrics, and investigate missing or inconsistent results. Organise your document sets in Parsewise projects and track extraction progress directly from your assistant.
defaultPrompt: Extract key fields from my documents with citations.
Show my Parsewise projects and processing status.
Find missing or inconsistent extraction results.
